key_insight: TopoFormer turns graph topology into short token sequences that a Transformer can read, combining topological structure with attention in a lightweight, scalable way.
engineering_relevance: It offers a parallelizable alternative to persistent homology pipelines for graph and molecular learning, with predictable compute and easy integration into standard deep learning stacks.
method: Topo-Scan slices node or edge filtrations into ordered topological tokens.
A Transformer processes the resulting sequence to learn graph-level embeddings.
The design captures multi-scale structure while avoiding costly diagram computations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art results on graph classification and molecular property prediction benchmarks, matching or exceeding strong GNN and topology-based baselines.
watch_item: The approach depends on how filtration slicing and token ordering are defined, so performance and stability may be sensitive to implementation choices.
paper_title: TopoFormer: Topology Meets Attention for Graph Learning
